boundedQuestion: Can a source-bound causal state contract prevent a ZX85 cab from being accepted when its pilot control shut-off lever is only visual or fails to gate start, travel, swing and front-attachment motion?

novelty.relativeToCurrentBestView: N318 binds LCD screens and controller events, but it does not bind the physical safety interlock that separates engine start from machine motion.

sourceFacts.fact: ZX85USB-5A requires LOCK_UP for engine start; the engine will not start in another lever position.
Before operation, confirm every control and pedal is neutral, then slowly push the lever down to UNLOCK.
If any actuator moves while controls remain neutral after unlocking, immediately return to LOCK and stop the engine.
ISO levers map arm roll-out/in and swing right/left on the left lever; boom lower/raise and bucket roll-in/out on the right lever.
Travel uses levers or pedals; paired forward/back commands and opposed commands define forward, reverse and spin turn.
With the engine running but the pilot lever not pushed down into operating position, the machine must not travel or operate boom, arm or bucket.

boundaries: The fixture gate validates state semantics, not the production excavator runtime.
The eight exact ISO joystick directions and travel-turn mappings are source facts but are not fully replayed in this bounded case.
No Mother branch, production asset, main branch or R2 rule is modified.
